description: Use when naming a product, company or project and you need to know which domains are free: checks up to 10 domain names in one call against the authoritative registry RDAP servers (DNS delegation as fallback for TLDs without RDAP) and returns registered / available / likely-available / unknown per name, with expiry and registrar for taken ones. Paid tool: x402 USDC on Base, $0.004 per successful call; call without payment to receive the PaymentRequired object.
